directAnswer: To use Git merge, first ensure you are on the branch you want to merge into, then execute 'git merge <branch-name>' to combine changes from the specified branch.
summary: Git merge is a command used to integrate changes from one branch into another, allowing for collaboration and feature integration.

sections.heading: Understanding Git Merge
sections.body: Git merge allows you to combine the changes from one branch into another. This is commonly used in collaborative workflows where multiple branches are developed in parallel.

sections.heading: Merge Strategies
sections.body: Git supports different merge strategies such as 'fast-forward' and 'three-way merge'. The default strategy is 'three-way merge', which creates a new commit if there are changes on both branches.

sections.heading: Resolving Merge Conflicts
sections.body: If there are conflicting changes, Git will prompt you to resolve them manually. After resolving, you must stage the changes and complete the merge with 'git commit'.

steps.title: Checkout the Target Branch
steps.detail: Use 'git checkout <target-branch>' to switch to the branch you want to merge changes into.

steps.title: Merge the Source Branch
steps.detail: Run 'git merge <source-branch>' to merge changes from the specified source branch into your current branch.

steps.title: Resolve Any Conflicts
steps.detail: If conflicts arise, manually edit the files to resolve them, then stage the changes with 'git add <file>' and complete the merge with 'git commit'.

steps.title: Verify the Merge
steps.detail: Use 'git log' or 'git status' to confirm that the merge was successful and that your branch is up to date.

faqs.question: What happens if I merge without committing?
faqs.answer: You will receive an error message indicating that there are uncommitted changes. You must commit or stash changes before merging.

faqs.question: Can I undo a merge?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can use 'git merge --abort' to revert to the state before the merge if conflicts occur, or 'git reset --hard HEAD' to discard all changes.

faqs.question: How do I merge multiple branches at once?
faqs.answer: You cannot merge multiple branches in a single command. You must merge one branch at a time into your target branch.

caveats: Merging can lead to complex conflicts if multiple branches have diverged significantly.
Always ensure your working directory is clean before merging to avoid complications.
